events.text: I'm out of credits, and the cheapest options, flux-2-klein and background removal, each cost 5, so neither will run. I'll explain that to the user.

I couldn't make the studio shot. Magic Hour turned down the edit because your account doesn't have enough credits, so no image was created.

That was already the cheapest edit your free plan allows: the flux-2-klein model, one image at 640px, costing about 5 credits. I don't have another free way to do it.

**To get it done:** add credits or buy a credit pack on your Magic Hour account, then tell me and I'll run it again with these settings:
- Plain white studio background replacing the cluttered room and grey floor
- The whole sneaker kept at the same side view, position, size, stitching, laces and sole
- A soft, natural shadow under the sole only
- Same wide shape as your original, with no text or extra objects

**About the shoe looking different:** that's a real risk with this kind of edit, because the tool redraws the whole image rather than just cutting out the background. A white shoe on a white background adds to it, since the edges can blend or get smoothed. The free plan also only goes up to 640px, which is smaller than your 1024px photo, so fine details like the stitching may come out a little softer. When it's done, I'll point out anything that changed.

Your current photo is a clean side view with good, even light on the shoe. The main thing hurting it is the messy background, so a plain white background should make it look much more polished.
